title: お腹ぺこぺこ！異界渡り鳥の休憩所
author: 春宮こより

en.title: Stomach Growling! The Rest Stop of Interdimensional Migratory Birds
en.premise: In a quiet corner of the city, I run a cozy haven for interdimensional travelers—called "migratory birds"—who wander from world to world. For them, this shop is a desert oasis, drawing hungry wanderers one after another. With tasty meals and lively chatter, it eases the weary travelers' hearts in a deliciously satisfying tale of comfort.

zh.title: 肚子咕咕叫！跨界迁徙鸟的休息站
zh.premise: 在城市的一个角落，我经营着一个为跨越世界旅行的“迁徙鸟”们提供休憩的温馨小店。对它们来说，这家店就像沙漠中的绿洲，饥饿的漂泊者络绎不绝。美味佳肴与热闹的聊天，让疲惫的旅人们的心灵得到放松，呈现一段令人垂涎的舒适故事。
